title: 反馈支路含电容的反相放大器
statement: 理想运放电路中 Us = 1∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R1 = 1 kΩ，反馈支路为 Rf = 2 kΩ 与 C = 0.5 µF 并联。
求输出电压 U_o（o 端对地）的有效值和相位，以及电容中的电流 I_C（参考方向见图）。

questions.explain: 反相端虚地，电容两端电压 0 − U_o = 1 − j V，I_C = jωC × (1 − j) = j0.5 mA × (1 − j) = 0.5 + j0.5 mA，模 0.707 mA。

questions.ask: 如果频率降得很低（ω → 0），这个电路的电压增益 |U_o/Us| 趋于多少？
choices: 2（电容相当于开路，就是普通的反相比例放大器 −Rf/R1）
questions.explain: ω → 0 时 1/(ωC) → ∞，电容支路相当于开路，Z_f → Rf，增益 → −Rf/R1 = −2。频率越高电容分流越多，增益越小——这是一个有源低通电路。

hints: 虚短、虚断在相量形式下同样成立：反相端 n 是虚地，R1 的电流全部流入反馈支路。
把 Rf 与 C 的并联写成一个复阻抗 Z_f，U_o = −(Z_f/R1)·Us。
solution: **4. 验算（结点 n 的 KCL）。** I_Rf = (0 − U_o)/Rf = (1 − j)/2 mA = 0.5 − j0.5 mA，I_Rf + I_C = 1 mA = I_1 ✓。

en.title: Inverting amplifier with a capacitor in the feedback
statement: In the ideal op-amp circuit Us = 1∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R1 = 1 kΩ, and the feedback branch is Rf = 2 kΩ in parallel with C = 0.5 µF.
Find the rms value and phase of the output voltage U_o (terminal o to ground) and the capacitor current I_C (reference direction as drawn).

questions.explain: U_o = −1 + j = 1.414∠135° V: the inversion contributes 180° and the angle of Z_f contributes −45°.
The inverting input is a virtual ground, so the capacitor voltage is 0 − U_o = 1 − j V and I_C = jωC × (1 − j) = j0.5 mA × (1 − j) = 0.5 + j0.5 mA, magnitude 0.707 mA.

questions.ask: If the frequency is made very low (ω → 0), what does the voltage gain |U_o/Us| approach?
choices: 2 (the capacitor is an open circuit; it is the ordinary inverting amplifier −Rf/R1)
questions.explain: As ω → 0, 1/(ωC) → ∞, the capacitor branch is open, Z_f → Rf and the gain → −Rf/R1 = −2. At higher frequencies the capacitor bypasses more current and the gain drops — this is an active low-pass circuit.

hints: Virtual short and virtual open hold for phasors too: the inverting input n is a virtual ground and all of R1's current goes into the feedback branch.
Combine Rf and C in parallel into one complex impedance Z_f; U_o = −(Z_f/R1)·Us.
solution: **1. Impedances.** Z_C = −j/(ωC) = −j2 kΩ, Z_f = Rf ∥ Z_C = 2k(−j2k)/(2k − j2k) = −j2k/(1 − j) = 1k − j1k Ω = 1.414 kΩ∠−45°.
**2. Virtual short and open.** U_n = 0, I_1 = Us/R1 = 1 mA, all of it into Z_f: U_o = 0 − Z_f·I_1 = −(1 − j) V = **−1 + j V = 1.414∠135° V**.
**4. Check (KCL at n).** I_Rf = (0 − U_o)/Rf = (1 − j)/2 mA = 0.5 − j0.5 mA, I_Rf + I_C = 1 mA = I_1 ✓.
